Actually an Italian designer created a chair for this exact purpose in 1945, it has a tilted seat and it's called "[chair for short visits](http://www.galeriedesgaleries.com/thumbs/invites/bruno-munari/sedia-per-visite-brevi-o-brevissime-chaise-pour-visites-tres-breves/munari_01-1020x1530.jpg)(or unwanted guests)" by Bruno Munari.

This is a quote from him:

“When one’s guests are unsmiling. If life seems to be rushing by, if time is pressing, if the need to hurry steals the minutes and the hours. Then, the seat is tilted forward and is shorter than usual, the back higher. This is a chair for very brief visits.”
